entries.text: markoto's writing assistant, image generation and voice input can run on your own AI provider account: Mistral, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible service, including a model on your own server. Your provider bills you directly, and your key is stored encrypted.

entries.caption: Each AI feature has its own provider card

entries.text: Connect a provider for the writing assistant

entries.caption: The form asks for the provider, its address, the model and your key
Pick your provider (here: Mistral), check the model and paste your API key

entries.text: Save: markoto checks the connection first

entries.caption: The connection works: the assistant now runs on your provider

highlights.label: Only the last four characters are shown

entries.text: Before saving, markoto sent a small test request with a tool definition through the same path the assistant uses, so a wrong key or an unknown model is caught here, not in the middle of your writing. You can re-check it with Verify or remove it at any time.
